# dsh-TUI (DSHTUI)

> dsh-TUI is a Claude Code-style fullscreen terminal interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It is community-maintained, open source, and available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Canonical website: https://dshtui.com/

## Names and identity

- dsh-TUI: preferred styled project name
- DSHTUI: domain-friendly name and common search alias
- dsh-tui: CLI command, profile, and package-name spelling
- DSH TUI: spaced search alias
- DSH: abbreviation for the underlying DeepSeek Harness
- npm package: @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui

All dsh-TUI, DSHTUI, dsh-tui, and DSH TUI references above describe the same terminal-interface project. DSH by itself refers to DeepSeek Harness.

## Install and launch

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui
dsh-tui
```

- License: MIT

## Key capabilities

- Streamed Markdown and structured tool cards
- Live agent status, context usage, cache hit rate, and TPS metrics
- Session resume, rewind, fork, compaction, and export
- Command and file completion with @ file references
- Chinese and English terminal interfaces
- Plugin mounting without modifying the DeepSeek Harness core
